summary: community.general keycloak_user_federation, keycloak_user_rolemapping and keycloak_userprofile moved to middleware_automation.keycloak.
questions: What is the new FQCN of keycloak_user_rolemapping?

answer_card.title: Keycloak modules moving out of community.general (part 8)
answer_card.answer_md:
Moved to the **`middleware_automation.keycloak`** collection. In community.general **14.0.0** these become deprecated redirects, and the redirects are removed in **16.0.0**. Install `middleware_automation.keycloak` now and update FQCNs:

- `keycloak_user_federation`
- `keycloak_user_rolemapping`
- `keycloak_userprofile`

Each becomes `middleware_automation.keycloak.<same name>`.
